item.title: Did Amanda Antoni Fall Down The Stairs Or Was It Murder?
item.description: In 2015, Amanda Antoni was found dead at the bottom of her basement stairs after her husband returned home from a business trip. Investigators ruled it a tragic accident, but a blood-soaked crime scene, unanswered forensic questions, and years of legal battles have left many wondering if the truth was ever uncovered.

item.title: The Fraternity Night That Turned Fatal
item.description: Tim Piazza died after suffering catastrophic injuries during a fraternity pledge event at Pennsylvania State University in 2017. Surveillance footage and the investigation revealed that members delayed calling for help despite his worsening condition. The case led to criminal charges, national outrage, and renewed scrutiny of fraternity hazing across the United States.

item.title: Did Josh Guimond Just Vanish From Campus?
item.description: Josh Guimond disappeared from the Saint John's University campus in November 2002 after leaving a card game with friends. Despite extensive searches and years of investigation, no confirmed trace of him has ever been found. His disappearance remains one of Minnesota's most puzzling unsolved missing person cases.

item.title: The Unexplained Disappearance Of Joan Risch
item.description: Joan Risch vanished from her Massachusetts home in 1961, leaving behind a scene filled with unanswered questions, scattered bloodstains, and no clear trace of where she went. Decades later, her disappearance remains one of America's most enduring unsolved mysteries.

item.title: A Bitter Divorce Turned Into Attempted Murder
item.description: The divorce between Diana Lovejoy and Greg Mulvihill escalated into a calculated murder plot in 2016. Prosecutors said Lovejoy conspired with firearms instructor Weldon McDavid to ambush Greg on a hiking trail, where he survived being shot. Both were later convicted for their roles in the attack.

item.title: The Love Triangle Behind Rusty Sneiderman's Death
item.description: The murder of Russell 'Rusty' Sneiderman sparked years of debate over who was truly responsible. While Hemy Neuman admitted to the shooting and was ultimately convicted, suspicion also surrounded Rusty's wife, Andrea Sneiderman, whose relationship with Neuman became central to the investigation. Prosecutors could not prove she conspired in the killing, though she was later convicted of lying under oath during the investigation.
